parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications sets a required default; there is no optional qualifications section.
Programming languages and open-source tools are examples for single asks, so their named examples are grouped as alternatives.
Distributed computing maps to distributed-systems; large-scale data processing has no exact taxonomy entry and is not assumed to mean data pipelines.
Technologies and practices mentioned only in Responsibilities are excluded.
Bachelor is the only degree level explicitly named; 'above' does not name a higher level.
